svg.text: Standard orientation: Power rails run horizontally on top & bottom; 5-hole terminal clips run vertically (A–E, F–J)

g.text: Runs horizontally along the top & bottom edges.
Power is available anywhere along the row!
are joined by a vertical spring clip underneath.
Column 5 does NOT connect to Column 6.
Rows are separate from one another.
The horizontal trench divides Row E from Row F.
Place your ESP32 or ICs across the trough:
Left pins go into A–E, right pins into F–J.
This prevents opposite chip pins from shorting!
⚠️ Never insert both chip pin rows on one side.
